note: Every promise a legal document makes. A document that cites a commitment can be published only when its status is implemented and its evidence names a file or test that proves it.

commitments.statement: The Stripe App requests only read permissions and never creates, changes or deletes anything in the customer's Stripe account, and never moves money.
SaasReport does not receive, store or process card numbers or bank account numbers.
Each customer's data is stored and read only under that customer's own tenant identifier; one customer cannot read another's data.
Every figure in a report is computed by deterministic code from Stripe data under published definitions; AI-written text is checked so that it contains no figure the code did not compute.
The AI provider receives only computed aggregates and never customer names, email addresses or other personal data from the customer's Stripe account.
After the customer uninstalls the app, the data derived from their Stripe account is deleted within the period stated in the privacy policy.
Report emails are sent only through SaasReport's own mail service on Cloudflare, and each carries the legal footer.
The website sets no cookies other than those strictly necessary, and runs no third-party advertising or tracking scripts.
SaasReport does not sell personal data, and does not use a customer's Stripe data to train AI models or to build benchmarks for other customers.
All traffic between Stripe, SaasReport's services, and report recipients' links uses encryption in transit.

Findings and recommendations in a report come from published rules applied to computed figures, not from AI judgement; each cites the figures that triggered it, and the thresholds are not benchmarks against other companies.
Reports are delivered as signed, expiring links to files stored under the customer's own tenant, and a link can be revoked.
